note: Temporary schema designed from the InfluxDB inventory of 5 Oct 2026 and the chatbot's Neo4j queries. Replace with the production team's schema; code reads every name from here.

timestamps.label: end
timestamps.note: A record stamped 01:15 covers 01:00-01:15. Per feed, timestamp_label can be "start".

detector_counts.purpose: Q2: raw (non-aggregated) SCATS counts per detector

site_kpi.purpose: Q3A/Q3B: existing Signal Performance KPIs per site

approach_perf.purpose: Q3C: existing phase service (green share) per approach link

tomtom_site_kpi.purpose: Q5: TomTom intersection KPIs stored in InfluxDB
tomtom_site_kpi.timestamp_note: End-labelled, confirmed 30 Oct 2026 (site 4397): the last record equals the window end; the latest quarter can arrive some minutes late.

tomtom_turn_kpi.purpose: Q5: TomTom approach and movement KPIs stored in InfluxDB
tomtom_turn_kpi.timestamp_note: End-labelled, confirmed 30 Oct 2026 (site 4397): the last record equals the window end; the latest quarter can arrive some minutes late.

cycle_length.purpose: Q3A fallback: subsystem active cycle length (subsystem value, shared by its sites)

graph.sites: MATCH (i:Intersection)-[:IN]-(:Region {tag: $region}) WHERE i.scats_site_no IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(i.signalised, true) = true RETURN DISTINCT toString(i.scats_site_no) AS site, i.latitude AS lat, i.longitude AS lon, i.street_names AS streets
graph.detectors: MATCH (d:Detector)-[:BELONG_TO]->(i:Intersection)-[:IN]-(:Region {tag: $region}) WHERE toString(i.scats_site_no) IN $sites RETURN toString(i.scats_site_no) AS site, d.detector_number AS detector, d.active AS active
graph.approaches: MATCH (i:Intersection)-[:IN]-(:Region {tag: $region}) WHERE toString(i.scats_site_no) IN $sites MATCH (i)-[:EGRESS]-(r:Road) WHERE r.link_id IS NOT NULL RETURN DISTINCT toString(i.scats_site_no) AS site, r.link_id AS link_id, r.street_name AS street

tomtom_queue.purpose: Q5 queue length: TomTom Junction Analytics archive, per-minute queue per approach (only when rules tomtom.api_enabled)
tomtom_queue.note: Same endpoint and parsing as the chatbot's TomTom layer (NT782/NT783). Credentials: TOMTOM_API_KEY, or TOMTOM_API_TOKEN with TOMTOM_AUTH_HEADER / TOMTOM_AUTH_PREFIX.
tomtom_queue.naive_timestamp_timezone_note: Archive stamps carry Z (UTC), confirmed 30 Oct 2026.

tomtom_mapping.note: TomTom ApproachId -> Neo4j EGRESS link_id per SCATS site (from the chatbot's TomTom layer).

ids.note: Link IDs can arrive with characters added by spreadsheet auto-formatting (e.g. a leading apostrophe). These are stripped from both ends before matching; nothing inside the ID is changed.
